cohort: The study included 27,181 pregnant women, comprising 5412 GDM cases and 21,769 non-GDM cases.
finding: Pregnant women with GDM have a higher risk of developing preeclampsia, and the co-occurrence of GDM and preeclampsia further increases the risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes such as preterm birth, cesarean section, and fetal growth restriction, with pp-BMI >24 kg/m2 and excessive GWG identified as risk factors for PE.
mod_finding: The risk of cesarean section increased further when preeclampsia occurred alongside gestational diabetes mellitus.
